lastResponse.text: I hear you, and I’m with you. Since you don’t feel safe where you are right now, please move to a public Place nearby if you can and call two one one now for immediate shelter help in Hillsboro. If anyone is threatening you or you’re in immediate danger, call nine one one right now. I can stay on the line with you while you make the call.
